test_title: PYST 2: DP Head Constable (AWO/TPO) 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 27 Oct 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Pointing towards a person in the photograph, Mrs Rajni said, "He is the brother's son of my husband's father-in-law Yogi." How is the person in the photograph related to Mrs Rajni?
solution:
Preparing the family tree using the following symbols:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3cec8f7ff91adc586ec8e3a7fbb10a48f0618ea71dc3e07c7c0b66a38287f43a.png] 

A possible tree diagram will be:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8aee0d7dfe52cd479b3d17806760dc6c3e182db7c3f8623652edddd62f7b5d9f.png] 

The relationship between Mrs. Rajni and the photograph is Father’s Brother’s Son.

Hence, the correct answer is "Father’s Brother’s Son".
